links.outcome: AI sensitivity for incidental pulmonary embolism in a randomly selected manually reviewed subset
links.effect: Sensitivity was 40% (95% CI 16-68) with 100% specificity; iPE prevalence in the subset was 1.7% (15/874). The AI missed most iPE cases in the reviewed subset.
links.quote: In the manually reviewed randomly selected subset, iPE prevalence was 1.7% (15/874, 95% confidence interval: 1.0-2.8%) with AI having 40% sensitivity (95% CI, 16-68) and 100% specificity (95% CI, 99.5-100).

unlisted_practices: Pre/post comparison of incidental pulmonary embolism detection rate after AI implementation in abdominal CT (0.57% vs 0.12%)

screen.reason: This study evaluates the real-world clinical impact before and after deploying an AI tool for incidental pulmonary embolism detection on abdominal CT, measuring changes in detection rates.
